retrievalProfile.description: A classic mid-century album layout featuring a large-scale serif artist name, a secondary sans-serif title, and a tilted scalloped-edge portrait on a solid color field.

recipe.visualDefinition: A solid teal-blue background serves as the canvas for high-contrast yellow and white typography. A black-and-white portrait is inset within a white, scalloped-edge frame, tilted slightly to the right, creating a 'scrapbook' or 'snapshot' effect against the formal grid of the text.
coreVisualRelationships: Primary yellow serif text dominates the top third
Secondary white sans-serif text spans the width below the name
A tilted rectangular photo anchor in the bottom right quadrant
A vertical list of track titles aligned to the left of the photo
coreInvariants: Scalloped-edge white border on the inset photograph
Tilted orientation of the inset image relative to the horizontal text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The portrait is positioned in the lower right, occupying approximately 30% of the total area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large yellow artist name at the top acts as the primary entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the top name, down to the title, then left to the tracklist, and finally right to the portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant solid blue space around the tracklist prevents the layout from feeling cluttered.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow for primary text and tracklist
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White for the album title and photo frame
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation blue with high-value yellow and white for maximum legibility.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to blue, yellow, white, and black-and-white photography

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of high-contrast transitional serifs and condensed grotesque sans-serifs.
letterConstructionRules: Primary name uses thick vertical strokes and thin horizontal serifs
Secondary title uses uniform stroke weight with no serifs
Tracklist uses a condensed version of the sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'P' and 'B' in the primary name have large, open counters
The 'S' in the title is highly compressed
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the name paired with a neutral, condensed sans-serif for supporting information.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast serif weight of the primary name
Matches the utilitarian feel of the secondary title

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid teal-blue background. In the lower right, place a black-and-white portrait of a man in a white suit, framed by a white border with scalloped edges and black corner tabs, tilted 5 degrees clockwise.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name in a large yellow high-contrast serif font at the top. Below it, add the album title in a white condensed sans-serif. List the tracks in a smaller yellow condensed sans-serif on the left side.

verificationChecks: Is the primary name yellow and serif?
Is the photo frame scalloped and tilted?
Is the background a solid, flat blue?
Is the tracklist aligned to the left of the photo?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the yellow text is legible against the blue
Ensure the photo border looks like a physical print
Verify the hierarchy: Name > Title > Tracks
Confirm no modern digital artifacts are present
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid color field + High-contrast serif header + Condensed sans-serif subheader + Tilted scalloped-edge inset photo.
